english.title: Seek / obtain leave to enter / remain in UK by deceptive means - immigration
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), not being a British citizen,

(A)_[obtained]_
(B)_[sought to obtain]_

leave to enter or remain in the United Kingdom by means including deception, namely **(..SPECIFY MEANS..)
english.legislation: Contrary to section 24A(1)(a) and (3) of the Immigration Act 1971.

english.notes:

other.powersofarrest:
Arrest without warrant

By section 28A of the Immigration Act 1971 (as amended by the Immigration and Asylum Act 1999) a constable may arrest without warrant a person who has committed or attempted to commit an offence under section 24 or section 24A of the Immigration Act 1971.
other.penalty:
SUMMARY: maximum 12 months imprisonment and / or a fine.
INDICTMENT: maximum two years imprisonment and / or a fine.

Time limit for prosecutions:
None

Note
The maximum penalty on summary conviction increased from 2nd May 2022, see section 32(1) of the Magistrates’ Courts Act 1980 as amended by section 282(1) of the Criminal Justice Act 2003. This applies only to offences committed on or after that date, see section 282(4). For offences committed before 2nd May 2022 the maximum penalty on summary conviction is six months.
